narrationTexts: No breaking changes this cycle. Now I'll write the 4.2.0 entry into CHANGELOG.md above the placeholder comment.
finalText:
**4.2.0 written to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

Went through all 380 commits and 128 PRs. No `Breaking` section, no major dep bumps this cycle.

One `Added`: webhook retries now use exponential backoff instead of dropping failed deliveries.

Nine `Fixed` items, deduped from repeat fixes across modules (queue, api, webhooks, db, etc.) into one line each — null cursor crashes in pagination, duplicate response headers, double-trimmed trailing slashes, empty allowlist handling, lost trace ids on retry, timer leak plus pool-close on HTTP shutdown, clearer token-parser errors, and 401 instead of 403 for expired tokens. Worth flagging: request bodies are no longer logged in full, a privacy fix I put first under `Fixed`.

Next: check the 401-vs-403 change doesn't need a `Breaking` callout for any client relying on 403.
